direction.broader_thesis: Agent orchestration is an underexplored design space. Most systems make orchestration choices implicitly — hard-coded, never measured, never optimized. Making them explicit, measurable, and optimizable is the research contribution.
direction.paper_1_thesis: Internal language choice should be studied as an orchestration policy over explicit agent messages — not as a claim about hidden cognition.
direction.generalized_formulation: For any orchestration variable σ: π(m_t, x_t) → σ_t. Language is σ = ℓ. But σ can be memory policy, planning depth, retry strategy, verification cadence, context allocation, observation granularity, tool scheduling, delegation topology, instruction hierarchy, or reasoning format.
direction.optimization_target: max_π U(π) = Success − λ_c·Cost − λ_t·Latency − λ_s·SafetyRisk − λ_m·MonitorabilityCost (applies to ALL orchestration variables. MonitorabilityCost term added after Abstract-CoT + OpenAI CoT monitoring research showed efficiency-monitorability tradeoff is fundamental)
direction.key_insight: Language is Paper 1 because it's the most tractable (easy to manipulate, easy to measure, clear priors). But the harness generalizes to any orchestration variable.
direction.danqi_caveat: World is changing fast — revisit settings, models, benchmarks before fall. Infrastructure and harness should be model-agnostic.

interaction_hypotheses: Language × memory: shorter language = more memory budget (multiplicative)
Language × planning: planning text is highest compression target
Reasoning format × verification: structured formats enable automatic verification
Memory × observation: summarized observations are easier to retain
Planning × retry: better plans → fewer retries → lower total cost
Context allocation × everything: meta-variable that mediates all others

key_papers_since_proposal.title: Thinking Without Words: Efficient Latent Reasoning with Abstract Chain-of-Thought
key_papers_since_proposal.authors: Ramji, Naseem, Fernandez Astudillo (IBM Research AI)
key_papers_since_proposal.finding: Learned discrete codebook of 64 abstract tokens achieves 11.6x fewer reasoning tokens than verbal CoT while matching performance. Power-law distribution emerges in abstract vocabulary. Cold-start RL alone fails — warm-up with verbal CoT guidance is required.
key_papers_since_proposal.impact_on_cotcodec: Changes the landscape fundamentally. Language routing (20-40% savings) is now the best inference-time-only approach; Abstract-CoT (80-92% savings) is the best post-training approach. Must cite, compare, and position against. Abstract CoT has NOT been tested on agent/tool-use tasks — open question for our benchmarks.

key_papers_since_proposal.title: PorTAL: Portable Task Adaptation Across Language Models
key_papers_since_proposal.finding: Task latent plus canonical hypernetwork and base alignment can generate LoRA adapters across model families, but the released target alignment still uses target-task labels and evaluation has prefix-sampling and held-out-test limitations.
key_papers_since_proposal.impact_on_cotcodec: Requires a corrected reproduction. Portable Sidecar Update Dynamics remains a high-collision hypothesis after learned-update prior-art review, not an automatic extension.

key_papers_since_proposal.title: Kimi Linear
key_papers_since_proposal.finding: KDA plus periodic global attention makes a production-scale linear-attention hybrid a strong baseline rather than a new direction.
key_papers_since_proposal.impact_on_cotcodec: Deprioritize generic attention replacement; test new state capabilities or dynamic operator routing.

key_papers_since_proposal.title: SR-TTT v2 corrected evaluation
key_papers_since_proposal.finding: The revision retracts original exact-memory gains after off-by-one and noncausal leakage; corrected evaluation reports zero exact matches in 2,250 paired trials.
key_papers_since_proposal.impact_on_cotcodec: All memory experiments now require startup-causality perturbations, exact generation, and storage/addressing/readout diagnostics.

research_plan.driver: Portable capsules are explicitly infrastructure. Causal Memory Holdout Trials remains the leading new mechanism: its randomized-assignment, replay, cross-fitted AIPW, prefix-lineage, and immutable-artifact CPU reference now returns a bounded SYMBOLIC_SENSITIVITY_PLUMBING_PASS across propensities 0.50, 0.25, and 0.10, but this is designed-effect plumbing evidence rather than a scientific result. Translation-Aligned Byte Boundary Transport has an exact alignment-sensitive NumPy doctor but no differentiable BLT integration. A real agent loop, engine-owned replay/tool instrumentation, 20–40-step environment, frozen-model adapter, signed evidence, and Slurm GPU path remain gating dependencies.
